title: AARO fishes for the program name and the people on it
summary: Dylan Borland tells of AARO fishes for the program name and the people on it, about 2023 at AARO, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: They wanted me to name the people that I knew that were working on the program. I refused to do it and they wanted the name of the program.

plain: Dylan Borland, a former Air Force intelligence specialist who has come forward with UFO claims, told podcast host Jesse Michels about his 2023 dealings with AARO, the Pentagon office now tasked with investigating unexplained objects in the sky. He says AARO wanted him to name the people he knew working on a secret programme and to give the programme's name, and that he refused. He tells it because, in his view, the office was more interested in finding the people involved than in revealing what they knew.
